digest.component_or_area: outbound sync and cross-project guard (applier, transport layer)
propositions: Outbound create mutations currently target a single construction-time project and fail if any create mutation key falls outside that configured project.
The cross-project guard must shift from equality check on a single project string to set-membership check against a mapping's project set.

Create target resolution must happen once at mutation build time in _compute_outbound_create_mutation, reading bridge_project from the ticket and validating against the projects mapping, then stamping the resolved project into the mutation fields under _bridge_target_project.

Both Cloud (ACLI) and Data Center transports must read _bridge_target_project from ticket_data and fall back to their construction-time project when absent, with DC dropping the reserved key before calling the Jira API.
Stale or typo bindings that resolve to projects absent from the mapping must emit no create mutation, closing a creation-side gap the guard cannot catch due to local-id placeholders.
